ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in central regions and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels localized on distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region across the inner 2/3 of both lobes. Right lobe distal margin contains four distinct, high-contrast dark circular spots (10-20 pixel diameter) arranged in a vertical arc on a white background. Left lobe margin exhibits high-intensity white pixels with smaller, irregular dark mottling near the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped bifurcation at approximately 48 degrees; the absolute vertex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray/pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes between 3 and 15 pixels. Right distal tip shows extreme jaggedness due to localized surface textures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve terminating in sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, 3D-textured clusters on the extreme tips of both lobes. Distinct dark circular pigmentation spots on the white distal portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity (white) linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 40 to 180 pixels in length, oriented diagonally and horizontally across the black central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on both lobe tips and multiple prominent white linear scars (rake marks) traversing the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical alignment of four dark circular spots on the outer white field of the right fluke lobe.
